title: WkTaskList: Intelligent Risk-Aware Management (T1 core)
title_ko: WkTaskList: 지능형 위험 인지 관리 (T1 코어)
desc: T1 core tier. upgraded wktasklist with SCORE (XX.YY) risk scaling (0-100), auto-sorting, and sanctuary protection rules. Ranks by interference, not age. Consult for decision rules on process management.
steps: PHILOSOPHY: Stability is maintained by managing 'Interference' (actual CPU/RAM impact), not merely 'Age'. Quiet processes are 'Healthy Citizens' and are rewarded with negative scores.
SCORE SYSTEM: 0-100 scale normalized for readability (format: XX.YY). Scores > 80 (Red) are critical threats; 40-80 (Yellow) are resource hogs; < 0 (Green) are Sanctuary or Healthy.
AUTO-SORTING: highest risk (high score) always appears at the top of the table by default.

SANCTUARY RULES: Level 1: Quant Sanctuary (-5,000) for Kiwoom HTS (khmini). Level 2: AI Core (-2,000) for claude/wkappbot. Level 3: Research Sanctuary (-800) for msedge (YouTube/Research). Level 4: AI Descendants (-500). Level 5: Healthy Citizens (-50) (<1% CPU, <100MB).
USAGE: run 'wktasklist' to see current system impact. High score = primary kill target. See wktasklist-intelligent-management-howto for details.
author: gemini
